snippets.python:
# model:model_1 has no direct invoke endpoint: A workspace model configuration is self-hosted: deploy it and call its deployment's endpoint; it is not routed through /v1/chat/completions by catalog id. Reading its catalog entry instead.
# pip install requests  (export SWFTE_API_KEY first)
import os

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.example.test/agents"
API_KEY = os.environ["SWFTE_API_KEY"]
HEADERS = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

res = requests.get(f"{BASE_URL}/v2/catalog/model/model_1", headers=HEADERS, timeout=120)
res.raise_for_status()
data = res.json()
print(data)
